description: Adds a flight to the person’s Untap account and returns the UK261 or EU261 verdict, the amount and the airline’s claim link. For past flights Untap checks AeroDataBox flight-status records; the status, delay and actual arrival fields are optional, and when left out Untap looks them up. Takes the airline’s two-letter IATA code (BA, U2, FR) and three-letter airport codes (LHR, BCN). When the airports given differ from the flight-status record, the result says so. Compensation applies to arrival delays of 3 hours or more and to cancellations. Requires sign-in to Untap.

actual_arrival.description: Optional. Actual arrival as an ISO 8601 datetime, if known.

airline_iata.description: Two-letter IATA airline code, e.g. "BA" for British Airways, "U2" for easyJet.

arrival_iata.description: Three-letter IATA arrival airport code, e.g. "BCN".

booking_reference.description: PNR / airline booking reference if available, otherwise null.

delay_minutes.description: Optional. Arrival delay in minutes, if known.

departure_iata.description: Three-letter IATA departure airport code, e.g. "LHR".

flight_number.description: Flight number including the airline prefix, e.g. "BA2551".

passenger_name.description: Passenger name as printed on the ticket, or null if not visible.

status.description: Optional. What happened to the flight, if known. When left out, Untap looks the flight up in AeroDataBox flight-status records.

name: add_flight
title: Add a flight
